newsitem.title: USA: Ligand adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Ligand adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Ligand Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday it adopted of a shareholder rights plan aimed at avoiding coercive or inadequate takeover attempts.

The plan is also designed to secure long-term value for shareholders, the company said in a statement. Under the plan, stockholders will get one preferred stock purchase "right" for each outstanding share of Ligand common stock.

The rights have an exercise price of $100 per right, subject to subsequent adjustment, and entitle the stockholder to purchase shares of Ligand common stock at a 50 percent discount under certain circumstances. The rights will not be exercisable until the occurrence of certain takeover-related events.
